text: Working on it. The bug: a required flag option (e.g. `@click.option("--foo", is_flag=True, required=True)`) is never reported as missing, because flag options get an implicit `default=False`, so `value_is_missing()` never sees a missing value. Fixing it in `src/click/core.py`.

Got it — this is the "no streams" case (e.g. `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` are `None` under `pythonw`): `echo()` and the progress bar crash instead of doing nothing. I'll fix the stream handling in `_compat.py`, `_termui_impl.py` and `utils.py`.
#1: still in progress, ETA ~8 min (fix identified in src/click/core.py, verifying against the full test suite now).
#2: still in progress, ETA ~15 min (the None-stdout/stderr handling in _compat.py, _termui_impl.py and utils.py).
#8: investigating now — it's about a flag option's value coming from `Context.default_map` in src/click/core.py. ETA ~8 min.

Verified with scratch tests (stdout/stderr/stdin all None) and the full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed (unchanged).
